column1: Purpose: Revenue, Expenses, Profit, and Net Margin for every month, quarter, and the full year, all pulled automatically from each month's tracker sheet.
1. Every month's Revenue, Expenses, Profit, and Net Margin pulls automatically from that month's own tab. Nothing here is typed in.
2. Quarterly and yearly totals on the right add up the matching months automatically.
3. Use the ChatGPT prompt at the bottom of this sheet to turn a raw bank or card statement export into rows ready to paste into a month's Transaction Log.
4. After pasting into a Transaction Log, pick the right Entity, Transaction Type, and Category from the dropdowns on each row. Everything else calculates on its own.
5. Delete any example rows in a month's Transaction Log before adding your real data. They're only there to show the format.
Prompt (Paste Into ChatGPT Along With Your Statement Export)
Turn your raw bank statement into rows ready to paste into your monthly transaction log. Double click the row below to see the full prompt.

Take the raw transaction data I paste below and convert it into a downloadable CSV file (not just CSV-formatted text in the chat) with these exact columns: Date, Entity, Transaction Type, Category, Merchant, Original Amount, Currency, Conversion Rate, USD Amount. Rules:
1) Only include real transactions. 2) Keep the Date and Merchant name exactly as shown in the export, in full, with no truncation. 3) Transaction Type is either Income or Expense, worked out from whether money came in or went out. 4) Leave Entity and Category blank for me to fill in from the dropdowns. 5) Original Amount and USD Amount must always be positive numbers, with no currency symbol and no thousands-separator commas. Whether it is income or an expense is captured only by the Transaction Type column, never by a negative sign. 6) USD Amount equals Original Amount multiplied by Conversion Rate. Use 1 if the transaction is already in USD. 7) Give me the CSV as a downloadable file, starting with a header row, with no extra commentary in the chat.
